=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- PR metadata (title/description):PR title: "review_autofix: swap z-ai/glm-5 → mistralai/codestral-2508 in reviewer panel" | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The PR title and description claim the change swaps to `mistralai/codestral-2508`, but the implementation uses `mistralai/mistral-small-2603`.
  WHY: This is a metadata-only mismatch that can mislead reviewers and maintainers about what model is actually deployed.
- scripts/codex_model_catalog.json:487-518 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `x-ai/grok-4.1-fast` entry is marked `supported_in_api: false` but remains `visibility: "list"`, so tooling that filters on visibility alone can still surface a dead slug.
  WHY: Consumers can present or schedule an unavailable model and then hit invocation failures when the model is requested.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:normalize_patch_path() (lines ~215-225) and parse_diff_git_paths() (lines ~228-235) + callers in parse_patch() | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Both functions unconditionally call `shlex.split` on git diff header lines and quoted paths, so paths with spaces or quotes can make `parse_patch()` drop files and return an empty map.
  WHY: `shlex.split` can raise `ValueError` or mis-tokenize, leaving `current_path/current_old_path` unset and making already-fixed rejections inconclusive, which repeats the same finding.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:extract_files_touched(), first_value(), parse_evidence_map (Python block ~290-310) and verify_already_fixed (~340) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: When `PR_DIFF_FILE` is empty or missing, the verifier returns `None/{}` without a distinct `diff_unavailable` verdict or log marker.
  WHY: Callers treat already-fixed items as open/inconclusive, causing ledger churn and repeated editor passes.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:top-level ROUND_NUMBER_BASE / AUTOFIX_ITERATION_VALUE / CURRENT_ROUND calculation (~40-55) and ARTIFACT_DIR construction | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The round calculation falls back from `ROUND_NUMBER` to legacy `AUTOFIX_ITERATION`, so wrapper runs that only export the old variable can pin `CURRENT_ROUND` to 1.
  WHY: That points artifact lookup at round-1 every iteration, breaking prior-round ledger lookups and the REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH/floor-rule contracts.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
